Shared tendency mode uses one tendency across all sections per synthetic respondent to demonstrate a positive Pearson association. A significant result is not guaranteed for every seed or sample size. Within-section correlated mode gives each test respondent a shared tendency within each section: each item follows it with 70% probability, otherwise it is sampled independently. The other modes sample every item independently. The generator does not target a correlation or hypothesis decision.
